title: Medicare Plan Comparison
description: Prices two caller-declared Medicare enrollment paths for a full year, Path A (Original Medicare plus Medigap plus stand-alone Part D) and Path B (Medicare Advantage), for a typical year and a bad-year stress test on 2026 CMS parameters. Returns both totals, the annual and bad-year differences and both worst-case ceilings, or a named refusal. Verify-only: it does not quote plans or compare networks.

irmaa_tier.description: IRMAA income band, 0 (base premium) to 5. Drives both the monthly Part B premium and the monthly Part D surcharge, on BOTH paths.

admissions_per_year.description: Expected inpatient admissions per year. Each admission opens one Part A benefit period and is charged the Part A deductible, the day coinsurance.

primary_visits_per_year.description: Expected primary care visits per year. Charged at ma_primary_copay_usd on Path B.

specialist_visits_per_year.description: Expected specialist visits per year. Charged at ma_specialist_copay_usd on Path B.

length_of_stay_days.description: Average inpatient length of stay in days. Days 61-90 cost the Part A days 61-90 rate and days 91-150 the lifetime reserve day rate.

outpatient_charges_usd.description: Expected annual outpatient and diagnostic charges, Medicare-approved amount.

annual_drug_cost_usd.description: Expected annual plan-negotiated retail drug cost. Priced through the standard Part D phase function on both paths (deductible, then 25% coinsurance.

medigap_premium_monthly_usd.description: Path A Medigap supplement premium per month. Quote from your county; varies widely by plan letter, age and state.

medigap_plan_type.description: Medigap plan letter. PlanG leaves the enrollee the Part B deductible and nothing else; PlanN adds the Plan N office visit copay.

part_d_premium_monthly_usd.description: Path A stand-alone Part D premium per month. Page pre-fills $35.09, the CMS 2026 Part D base beneficiary premium.

part_d_deductible_a_usd.description: Path A Part D plan deductible in dollars. A plan deductible cannot exceed the 2026 standard maximum ($615).

ma_premium_monthly_usd.description: Path B Medicare Advantage plan premium per month, above the Part B premium every Medicare beneficiary pays.

part_b_giveback_monthly_usd.description: Monthly rebate of the Part B premium offered by the Advantage plan. Path B premiums are floored at zero when the giveback exceeds them.

ma_primary_copay_usd.description: Path B primary care copay per visit.

ma_specialist_copay_usd.description: Path B specialist copay per visit.

ma_inpatient_copay_per_day_usd.description: Path B inpatient copay per day.

ma_inpatient_copay_days.description: Number of days the Path B inpatient copay applies to per admission; days beyond it are not charged by this model.

ma_outpatient_coinsurance_pct.description: Path B outpatient coinsurance as a percentage of outpatient charges. 20% is the Original Medicare rate for comparison.

ma_moop_usd.description: Path B in-network maximum out-of-pocket limit in dollars, covering Part A and B services only (Part D has its own $2,100 limit).

ma_drug_coverage_included.description: True when the Advantage plan bundles Part D. False means Path B charges the full retail drug cost and the Part D out-of-pocket cap does not protect.

ma_plan_drug_deductible_usd.description: Path B plan drug deductible in dollars, clamped to the 2026 standard maximum the same way part_d_deductible_a_usd is and flagged.

bad_year_admissions.description: Admissions in the stress-test year. Optional; defaults to 2 (the Apex page's shipped default).

bad_year_length_of_stay_days.description: Length of stay in the stress-test year. Optional; defaults to 7.

bad_year_charge_multiplier.description: Multiplier applied to outpatient charges and drug cost in the stress-test year. Optional; defaults to 3.

part_b_premium_by_irmaa_tier_usd.description: Optional override of the six monthly Part B premiums by IRMAA tier. Defaults to the 2026 CMS figures [202.90, 284.10, 405.80, 527.50, 649.20.

part_d_irmaa_surcharge_by_tier_usd.description: Optional override of the six monthly Part D income-related adjustments. Defaults to the 2026 CMS figures [0, 14.50, 37.50, 60.40, 83.30, 91.00].

part_b_deductible_usd.description: Optional override. 2026 Part B annual deductible. Default 283.

part_a_deductible_usd.description: Optional override. 2026 Part A inpatient hospital deductible per benefit period. Default 1736.

part_a_days_61_to_90_coinsurance_usd.description: Optional override. 2026 Part A daily coinsurance for days 61-90 of a benefit period. Default 434.

part_a_lifetime_reserve_coinsurance_usd.description: Optional override. 2026 Part A daily coinsurance for lifetime reserve days. Default 868.

part_d_max_deductible_usd.description: Optional override. Maximum Part D plan deductible for the vintage, used to clamp both plan deductibles. Default 615.

part_d_out_of_pocket_cap_usd.description: Optional override. Annual Part D out-of-pocket threshold for the vintage. Default 2100 (the same figure art-617 carries as 210000 cents).

plan_n_office_visit_copay_usd.description: Optional override. Medigap Plan N copay per office visit. Default 20.

high_deductible_plan_g_deductible_usd.description: Optional override. High-deductible Plan G annual deductible. Default 2950, the official 2026 figure.

valid_input.description: False when any input fell outside the declared domain; no money figure is produced in that case.

domain_errors.description: Named reasons the input was refused.

typical_year.description: Both paths priced for the declared scenario.

bad_year.description: The same shape as typical_year, priced with the stress-test scenario.

bad_year_scenario.description: The resolved stress-test assumptions actually used, including whether defaults were applied.

annual_difference_usd.description: Path A total minus Path B total.

path_a_worst_case_ceiling_usd.description: Null means no annual maximum (Original Medicare with no supplement).

constants_used.description: Every 2026 parameter the run actually used.

constant_overrides.description: Caller-declared constant overrides with the official 2026 value beside each one.

cites.description: CITES.md ids grounding every premise in this run.
